Level 3 Nursery Nurse - Worthing

Looking for a role where no two days are the same? We're on the hunt for a qualified Level 3 Nursery Nurse to join our happy and hardworking team in Worthing. If you love messy play, story time, and helping little ones discover the world, this could be the perfect fit!

The essentials:

  • Salary: 27,600 per year

  • Hours: 40 per week, Monday to Friday

  • Location: Worthing

As a Level 3 Nursery Nurse, you'll plan fun activities, support learning and development, and make sure every child feels safe, happy, and valued. From painting to problem-solving, you'll be right there encouraging those "wow" moments every day.

Perks you'll love:

  • Generous childcare discount.

  • Ongoing training and career development.

  • Recognition awards and celebrations.

  • Employee wellbeing support.

  • A warm, welcoming team in the heart of Worthing.

We're looking for a positive, enthusiastic Level 3 Nursery Nurse with a full Level 3 childcare qualification and the passion to inspire young minds.

So, if you're ready to bring energy, creativity, and a smile to work every day, apply now and become our next superstar Level 3 Nursery Nurse in Worthing!
